ModMetaData.name: VFE Classical - Republic Lectern
ModMetaData.author: Dibolic
ModMetaData.description:
A management hub for the Republic factions of Vanilla Factions Expanded - Classical.
Build the Republic lectern (Misc menu). Select it to open a window with tabs: the senators tab lists each Republic, whether you have rallied it and how many senators are favorable. The lectern also gives one shortcut per Republic to its senators window (read-only, as in the Factions tab).
Other mods can add their own tabs to the lectern with a LecternPanelDef, without any patch.
Requires Harmony and Vanilla Factions Expanded - Classical. Supports RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7.
